notes: them after put is added, as in v.18, since נָתַן writes no object morpheme.

The italicized the head of is treated as added under rule 20's supplied-lexical-verb-and-noun boundary: head names a further referent with a relation of its own rather than completing the lexeme separation. Folding it into נִזְרוֹ under rule 31 was the competing analysis, and the ASV italic corroborates without deciding (rule 7).
upon the hands of the Nazirite is rule 29's arthrous case: the article takes the the before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one.
